name: @kiwa-test/astro
description: Astro Server Endpoints (`pages/api/*.ts`) + `.astro` page SSR + View Transitions API test adapter for kiwa — invoke endpoint functions with simulated APIContext, render `.astro` pages with redirect / notFound / rewrite capture, and dispatch View Transitions lifecycle events (astro:before-preparation / after-preparation / before-swap / after-swap) without a running Astro dev server (part of the kiwa test framework family)

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/invoke-endpoint.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/render-astro-page.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/setup-view-transition-env.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/src/index.js'
